title: Measuring visualisation usage and related orders
description: Separate preview activity, related orders and business outcomes. App dashboard observations can describe use and association; they do not by themselves.
answer: Separate preview activity, related orders and business outcomes. App dashboard observations can describe use and association; they do not by themselves establish that previews caused higher conversion or lower returns.
body:
Define each measure before comparing it

Keep a record of the observation window, eligible products, preview activity and related orders. An outbound click on this marketing website is not an app installation or a storefront purchase.

A practical review checklist

  • Record usage separately from related orders.
  • Use matching periods and comparable products.
  • Account for promotions, traffic mix and catalogue changes.
  • Use an appropriate controlled experiment before claiming a causal uplift.

AI-generated previews illustrate appearance and placement. They do not provide measured dimensions, guaranteed scale or a live camera-based AR view. Shoppers should check product measurements before buying.

Use the app’s documented workflow

Room Refresh is a Shopify app for furniture and home-decor merchants. Shoppers upload a room photo and generate a preview of a product in that space, directly from a product page.

Start with setup instructions, inspect the current product examples, and check plans and usage charges. Ask support about your specific store before treating an assumption as a product feature.
